app TypedCohortJourney
Given
 Entry { label:text, applicable:bool=true, consent:bool=true, count:int=0, who:text="", scope:text="", invocation:text="", origin:text="" }
 policy Entry read=members
When
 crud Entry by=owner fields=label,applicable,consent
 ## The cohort executor must admit each child afresh and commit these authored effects with its durable outcome.
 scenario process(entry:Entry) -> int by=owner
  do
   require entry.applicable
   set entry {count=entry.count+1,who=actor.id,scope=team.id,invocation=operation.id,origin=operation.source}
   require entry.consent
   return entry.count
Then
